scenarios.name: Geopolitical Escalation in Asia
scenarios.description: Escalation of tensions between the U.S. and China over Taiwan, coupled with redirected global supply chains affecting semiconductor and energy markets.

impacts.explanation: Disrupted supply chains reduce manufacturing capacity.
Increased defense spending to counter escalation.
Market volatility drives demand for safe-haven assets.

scenarios.reasoning: Historical precedents (e.g., 2018-2019 trade wars) make this a plausible risk. Probability adjusted for measured tensions.
tetlockCommandments: Break seemingly intractable problems into tractable sub-problems

scenarios.name: Inflation Moderation
scenarios.description: Sustained decline in energy prices and supply chain stabilization reduce core inflation.

methodology: Applied probabilistic thinking with outside views, balancing inside views (current data) against base rates (historical economic cycles).
geopoliticalSummary: High risk of China-Taiwan conflict, Middle East proxy conflicts, and renewed Russia-Ukraine tensions.
geoeconomicSummary: Persistent supply chain vulnerabilities, dollar strength, and elevated trade deficits.
currentEventsSummary: Ongoing semiconductor shortages, energy price declines, and mixed consumer spending resilience.
